questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The number of visitors ______ from 5,000 to 8,000 last year.
questions.explanation: last year表示过去，用过去式rose。
questions.evidence: This year, after the panel's review, the figure rose to 78%.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The new rule ______ next September.
questions.evidence: The council accepted this change, and the new rule will start next September.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The system issued 12,000 fines in 2022, but the number ______ to 9,500 in 2023.
questions.evidence: In 2023, the number fell to 9,500, a decrease of about 21%.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: Westfield's approach was ______ expensive than Riverton's.
questions.evidence: The panel found that Westfield's approach was more expensive but produced fewer mistakes.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The panel recommended reducing the factor ______ 40% to 25%.
questions.evidence: They recommended that the time-on-list factor should be reduced from 40% to 25% of the total points.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: About 3% ______ fines were sent to the wrong owner.
questions.explanation: 百分比后接of表示“……的百分之……”。
questions.evidence: About 3% of fines were sent to the wrong car owner.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The council ______ on these principles in June.
questions.evidence: The council will vote on these principles in June.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The panel found that Westfield produced ______ mistakes than Riverton.
questions.explanation: mistakes是可数名词复数，比较级用fewer。
questions.evidence: The panel found that Westfield's approach was more expensive but produced fewer mistakes.

title: When Algorithms Decide: A Panel on Limits · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在描述数据时，我们常用不同的动词和结构来表达趋势、比较和比例。表示上升可用 rise, increase, go up；表示下降可用 fall, decrease, drop。注意时态：过去的数据用过去时（rose, fell），预测或未来安排用将来时（will start, will vote）。比较级用于两者比较：more expensive than, fewer mistakes than。比例常用百分比：72% of applicants, a decrease of about 21%。数据句要准确：数字、百分比、时间必须与事实一致。

This year, after the panel's review, the figure rose to 78%.
